svg.text: Performance architecture: 2s emergency budget, 3 cache layers, Reserved Tier
PoC v4 (on-demand, no cache): Emergency TTFT 2.5s, Complex TTFT 9.7s. Target with Reserved Tier + Prompt Cache: 2s / 6s.
Emergency lane waterfall (Haiku 4.5, target p95 less than 2s)
[ 20 ms] L1 semantic cache lookup (ElastiCache Redis OSS)
[ 100 ms] Cognito JWT + Comprehend Medical DetectPHI
[ 230 ms] Vector kNN top-3 + GraphRAG top-2 (PoC: 1300 ms)
[ 400 ms] Haiku 4.5 TTFT with Bedrock Prompt Cache hit (PoC: 1100 ms)
[1200 ms] Haiku 4.5 full 300-token answer (streaming)
[ 120 ms] Citation validator + chat_trace (no guardrails on emergency)
Target p95: 1.9s. PoC measured: 2.5s. Cached path: 300-500 ms.
Complex lane waterfall (Sonnet 4.5, target p95 less than 6s)
[ 20 ms] L1 semantic cache lookup
[ 100 ms] Auth + PHI mask
[ 150 ms] Router agent (Nova Micro, JSON only)
[ 200 ms] Vector top-15 + GraphRAG top-3 (PoC: 1500 ms)
[ 600 ms] Sonnet 4.5 TTFT (PoC: 7700 ms with 18 chunks)
[4000 ms] Sonnet 4.5 streaming + side-channel agents + guardrails
Target p95: 5-6 s. PoC measured: 12 s. Reserved + Cache cuts ~50%.
Three-layer cache stack
L1: Semantic cache (ElastiCache Redis OSS)
embed query, ANN lookup against cached Q/A pairs
cosine threshold 0.93, 30-45% hit, TTL 24 h, tag invalidation on ingest
L2: Bedrock Prompt Caching
explicit cachePoint marker on system prefix, 5-min TTL
Claude 4.x and Nova supported, ~50% input token reduction, ~85% TTFT cut
L3: Bedrock Reserved Tier
dedicated throughput on emergency lane, no cold-start penalty
sized to peak TPM, queue protection + predictable latency
Auto-scaling and load management

g.text: Lambda reserved + provisioned concurrency on chat, scales with API GW TPM
OpenSearch Serverless auto-scales OCUs based on indexing and query load
Per-tenant API GW usage plans enforce rate limits and prevent noisy-neighbor
CloudWatch alarms on p95 breach trigger PagerDuty + auto-rollback

svg.text: Streaming architecture (PoC v4)

g.text: FastAPI async generator + asyncio.Queue + thread worker for converse_stream
Singleton boto3 clients (bedrock-runtime, bedrock-agent-runtime) avoid per-request overhead
Uvicorn direct on port 80, no reverse proxy buffering
SSE events flushed immediately as tokens arrive from Bedrock
